resources.string: The phone manages alarms, reminders, and timers on your home server. The server owns execution; this app does not use AlarmManager, FCM, or a built-in VPN.
Full http:// or https:// URL. LAN address, IPv4, bracketed IPv6, or Tailscale MagicDNS. No query or credentials.
Where the device and scenario catalog lives, e.g. http://192.0.2.28:8099. Leave blank to disable the Home tab. The same bearer token is sent to it.
HTTP is not encrypted. Use HTTPS when the server provides a trusted certificate; HTTP is intended only for an explicit local/Tailscale setup.
Leave blank to keep the stored token. It is encrypted with a non-exportable Android Keystore key and is never logged or put in a URL.
The stored token cannot be decrypted on this device. Enter it again to restore access.
Scenario execution is not implemented by this server version.
Schedules stay authoritative on the home server. This screen only manages server state.
Phone-side reminder notifications are not implemented in this foundation.
Settings are saved. Use “Save and test connection” to verify the server.
